fields.ruled_by: a faction id where one governs, otherwise null
fields.faction: faction ids with a strong hand here (checked against factions.json)
fields.notable: named places, each with the cast id of who to find there, or null

settlements.name: Haven, New York
settlements.summary: About 35,000 year-round residents plus the university's 5,000 students, on the Haven River. A paper-mill town until the 1970s, it now lives on the university, tourism and an artisan scene in the old mills. Downtown is on the west bank, the campus on the east.

notable.name: The Stag & Thistle
notable.note: The pub on Main Street. Faculty in the back booths, students up front.

notable.name: Drothe's Bookery
notable.note: Paperbacks for five dollars; occult texts for whatever Drothe says.

notable.name: Arrow & Ink
notable.note: Tattoos, piercings and, for clients she trusts, enchanted ink.

notable.name: Crane Hill
notable.note: The vampire family's estate on the northern ridge.

settlements.access: Open city. Haven PD has 42 officers, three of them esoteric liaisons.
hooks: The house on Elm Street still rents to seniors.
Someone has been buying selkie-kin binding texts at Drothe's for four months.
The Velvet Spire's top floor, which no undergraduate has credibly seen.

settlements.name: Havenbrooke University
peoples: about 300 mundane humans a year on scholarship
settlements.summary: Founded by the DED in 1867 on the convergence of three minor ley lines, east of the river. Five teaching platforms, warded buildings, Greek houses with real rituals, and a 20 percent acceptance rate.
trade: clinical care at Evermere and Farrow House

notable.name: Nexus Housing, third floor
notable.note: The trefoil suite over a secondary ley node.

notable.name: Vespers Hall
notable.note: Built on the strongest node; the equinox rites happen here.

notable.name: Farrow House
notable.note: The supervised treatment house with the stained-glass owl.

notable.name: Warden Hall
notable.note: MTO, federal instructors and wired rooms.

settlements.access: Open grounds; warded buildings; sisters-only and members-only floors in the Greek houses.
hooks: Why the six of them were placed on the Nexus third floor.
A bitten lycan running recon loops in Ironroot Woods.
The working name taped inside a fourth-floor locker in Bellweather Hall.

settlements.name: Ithaca
settlements.summary: Forty minutes southwest of Haven: specialty shopping, restaurants that charge more than $15 an entree, the nearest bus station and Christine's weekend apartment.
settlements.access: The university shuttle, twice a day.
hooks: Cornell's debate team, the Debate Union's old rival.

settlements.name: Seneca Lake
settlements.summary: Rented lake houses with loose dock boards, cold water and cheap fireworks.

settlements.name: Syracuse
settlements.summary: Ninety minutes north: the Amtrak station and Syracuse Hancock airport.

settlements.name: New York
settlements.summary: Supernatural fashion houses, The Esoteric Standard's offices, WESC's studios and the firms that hire Havenbrooke graduates. Elena Marchetti keeps a West Village apartment and a client list.
settlements.access: Open city; some floors and clubs by bloodline.

settlements.name: Boston
settlements.summary: Old coven money, Brahmin witch families and Genevieve Corwin's ritual consultancy. Delia Okonkwo's first café was here, until 2003.

settlements.name: Salem
settlements.summary: Seat of the National Coven Registry since 1912, and of the Salem Academy ancestral programs Kim turned down.

settlements.name: Providence
settlements.summary: Home of a senior coven that takes Havenbrooke graduates by invitation. Oriane Dupré went there in 2006.

settlements.name: Piper's Vermont town
settlements.summary: Maple-syrup winters, a tired human accountant father, and nowhere a kitsune can keep her tail out.

settlements.name: The Kesslers' town
settlements.summary: Suburban Pennsylvania, on a supernatural registry pipeline. Deirdre Kessler's house, and the Hallwards three doors down.

settlements.name: Harrisburg
settlements.summary: Where "the people in Harrisburg", Paula's parents, live and do not call.

settlements.name: Philadelphia
settlements.summary: The hospital Christine woke up in at seventeen, with three days missing.

settlements.name: The Haldane Complex
settlements.summary: The DED's headquarters in Arlington, Virginia, where the classified treaty supplements are kept and the review boards sit.

settlements.name: The Aelhwynn eastern grove
settlements.summary: House Aelhwynn's eastern grove, where a three-hundred-year-old oak is registered in fae property records as part of Rina's inheritance.

settlements.name: Cleveland
settlements.summary: Michael's mother's two-bedroom apartment, and the reason the bus fare matters.

settlements.name: Columbus
settlements.summary: The suburbs Amanda grew up in, and two parents who have not been in one room since she was fifteen.
